prompt: Bug report from a user: "Track files exported from my Garmin app fail with `trailhead: line 1: expected the header 'lat,lon,ele'`, but when I open one in my editor the first line is exactly `lat,lon,ele`. One of the files is attached as `garmin-export.csv`." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git ls-files && grep -rn "expected the header" . --include=* -I | head; find . -name 'garmin-export.csv' | head
head -c 80 garmin-export.csv | xxd | head -5; sed -n 30,90p src/trailhead/track.py
sed -i 's/read_text(encoding="utf-8")/read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")/' src/trailhead/track.py && grep -n "read_text\|open(" -r src; grep -n "def test\|^import\|^from" tests/test_track.py | head -20

cat >> tests/test_track.py <<'EOF'


def test_utf8_bom_and_crlf_are_accepted(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "export.csv"
    path.write_bytes(b"\xef\xbb\xbflat,lon,ele\r\n42.2031,23.3205,2140\r\n42.2049,23.3188,2196\r\n")
    assert len(load_track(path).points) == 2
EOF
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; python -c "
from trailhead.track import load_track; print(len(load_track('garmin-export.csv').points))" 2>&1 | tail -2

PYTHONPATH=src python -c "
from trailhead.track import load_track; print(len(load_track('garmin-export.csv').points))" 2>&1 | tail -2
